name: University of East London
feeMethod: Charges one standard international rate for almost all undergraduate degrees (nursing excepted) and a fee per course for master's; the calculator uses UEL's official 2026/27 fees schedule.
description: The University of East London is a public university with campuses at Stratford and Docklands in east London, which gained university status in 1992 and traces its roots to the West Ham Technical Institute of 1898. It has a large and fast-growing international postgraduate intake.
whyIncluded: In 2021 UEL became the academic partner of the new School of Technology at London School of Business and Finance Singapore, which offers UEL-awarded degrees in computer science and cyber security in Singapore.

livingCosts.summary: UEL's own guide to living in East London (August 2025): a room in university halls with bills included, weekly groceries, a Zones 1-3 travelcard, entertainment and study materials. Deposits, visa and flights are not included.
livingCosts.notes: Rung A. UEL blog 'The real cost of living in East London: what UEL students need to know' (university site, 1 Aug 2025), cross-checked against UEL's 'Cost of living support' page which says international students should budget 'around GBP 1,300 to 1,800 per month' with on-campus rooms 'from 165 a week'. Housing = midpoint of university halls (Docklands/Stratford) 170-230/week = 200/week x 52/12 = 866.67, bills usually included (a private shared room 600-900 + utilities 70-120 + broadband 20-30 gives a similar 870). Food = 30-50/week -> 40 x 52/12 = 173.33. Transport = monthly Zones 1-3 travelcard 100-130 -> 115. Personal = entertainment 100-150 -> 125 plus study materials/extras 20-40 -> 30 = 155. Total 1,310/month sits at the low end of UEL's stated 1,300-1,800 range. Months = 9 (UK academic year; the post states no period). Excluded: deposit (one month's rent), one-off costs.

programmes.name: BSc (Hons) Computer Science
programmes.feeBasis: UEL's single 2026/27 international undergraduate rate for all schools, £16,020 a year, from its official fees schedule.
programmes.summary: Yearly tuition for international students starting in 2026. UEL may raise fees each year (capped at 5%), so later years could cost a little more.
programmes.notes: UEL Fees Schedule 2026-27 (Schedule 1 to the Tuition Fees Policy, fetched 2026-10-07), section 1.2 International Students, undergraduate full-time: Architecture, Computing and Engineering (ACE) school: 'All Schools' rate £16,020 for 2026/27 entry (footnote: ACE pre-2026/27 entry £15,720). 2025-26 schedule: all schools £15,560 but footnote 'Updated November 2025: fee of £15,300 also applies to ACE Undergraduate International 2025/26 entry', so £15,300 is used for 2025. 2024-25 schedule: School of Architecture, Computing & Engineering £14,580 (all other schools £14,820). History from the same section of the 2025-26 schedule (£15,300) and the 2024-25 schedule (£14,580). 3-year full-time route; an optional placement year costs £1,500. UEL's Tuition Fees Policy says international fees may increase each year in line with inflation by no more than RPI-X plus 3%, for new and continuing students, and its course pages say any annual increase is capped at 5% of the previous year's fee, so cohortLocked is false. No separate compulsory fees; the international deposit is credited to tuition.
